syntax.import: #[dotnet_import(assembly = "InteropFixtures", type = "InteropFixtures.Math", member = "Add", signature = "System.Int32(System.Int32,System.Int32)")] extern "dotnet" { pub fn add(left: i32, right: i32) -> i32; }
syntax.export: #[dotnet_export(namespace = "RustSharp.Interop", type = "Exports", member = "Add")] pub fn add(left: i32, right: i32) -> i32 { left + right }
syntax.reference: dotnet::Object<T> is an owning managed handle; &dotnet::Object<T> is a call-scoped nonescaping shared loan; &mut dotnet::Object<T> is an exclusive loan
syntax.nullable: Option<dotnet::Object<T>> is the explicit nullable-handle adapter; nonnullable handles reject null at the boundary
syntax.errors: #[dotnet_error(result)] maps declared exceptions to Result<T, dotnet::Error>; #[dotnet_error(panic)] enters the existing unwind/abort profile
syntax.generic: explicit closed type arguments and metadata constraints; no inferred overload or runtime generic construction
